svg.title: Book Tracker route access and write boundaries
svg.desc: Routes are grouped by their effective access boundary. Personal library and shared-work pages require sign-in, public profiles require publication, and admin routes require the fixed verified operator. Catalog mutations additionally require recent authentication.
